body:
Thanks!

I can confirm that this PR fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/123964, both in my MRP and the project where I originally encountered the issue (which has more uses of audio than just the problematic loop, and all of it is working fine)

> i'm new around here, but would love to contribute - i'm not sure if this kind of feedback is desired or not, i'll leave it at this unless i come across any bugs in testing!

@jgill88 thank you very much for your review, this is very welcome feedback :pray: .

> mostly things that jumping out at me are jsdoc inconsistencies and unnecessary verbosity that could be tidied up.

Please note that the JSDoc is meant to be consumed by the [Closure Compiler](https://github.com/google/closure-compiler/wiki/Annotating-JavaScript-for-the-Closure-Compiler) and its dialect might vary from your IDE (notably objects are nullable by default).

Most of the "verbose" types are there so the CC can enforce type-checking and warn/error[*] if you try to e.g. assign the wrong type, and some are there as "casts" to e.g. ensure the proper narrowing/nullability status.

Overall it is a bit more verbose than strictly needed, but I decided to also add explicit typing to all "private members" of Bus/VolumeMixer/Stream/Playback for sanity.

In any case, thanks again for the feedback, I have addressed the highlighted issues fixing a few bogus annotations, typing the stream options, and adding explicit nullability to all object types (which should also be compatible with your IDE).

[*]: NOTE: Closure Compiler warnings/errors are currently hidden/disabled in `master`, I'll open a separate PR that re-enables them (along with a few needed fixes) soon.
